title: Moth: a 19.7 MB Italian-English code-switching speech recognizer (0.8.1)
description:
Moth is a very small open Italian + English code-switching speech-to-text model: a pretrained Whisper-tiny encoder (MIT), two additional transformer blocks and a linear CTC head over a shared IT+EN SentencePiece BPE. Release 0.8.1 is an 11.9 MB INT8 ONNX graph in a 19,706,289-byte package and runs in the browser via ONNX Runtime Web/WASM and on CPU.

Reference results: 24.08% WER / 55.23% ETA on the 600-utterance recorded mixed test set; 20.16% WER on filtered FLEURS-IT. The code-switching evidence is scripted read speech from three known voices; the paper documents the evidence boundary, the negative results and the full experiment ledger.

The repository contains the code, experiment records, per-utterance hypotheses, release records and paper source. Audio, checkpoints and mel shards are not in the repository; the recorded dataset is published separately under CC-BY-4.0.
notes: Code Apache-2.0; Whisper and Silero notices in NOTICE. The recorded dataset is CC-BY-4.0. The paper is a preprint.
